METAL_BASE_METAL_QI_AWAKENING.why: Metal Qi Awakening lets a Metal-sphere character use Metal talents through their body, a held or worn metal object, a touched metal object, a metal projectile, mineral dust, ore-bearing ground, or a temporary metal-qi projection created by a Metal talent. Metal talents already work through these media; the awakening adds no separate combat action. It grants no weapon proficiency, no armor proficiency, no Blacksmith tools, no permanent item crafting, and no broad control over all metal in sight.
